title: Dispatch: search by description
problem_line: Find a person in a red shirt and jeans somewhere in a block, among other people, without a face.

beats.caption: On the pad. The request: red shirt, jeans, last seen on South Road.
Search legs over the area. Everyone the detector sees is compared by clothing words.
People who do not match are noted and passed over.
A clear match: tracked, and reported from the pad by distance and bearing.

success_line: Matched the described person, never anyone else, and reported where they are from the pad.
